The DM wants to create a detailed plan that an NPC will attempt to enact to achieve his apotheosis (transformation, ascension, or god-making moment). 

Start by reading the vault context:
1. Active campaign note from Configuration.md (active_campaign link)
2. The relevant NPC note(s) — ask me which NPC this apotheosis concerns if there's ambiguity
3. The active world and party context to understand power level and existing threads

Then help the DM develop a step-by-step plan the NPC will follow: key milestones, resources needed, obstacles, allies/enemies involved, and how this ties into campaign arcs. Work iteratively — outline first for DM approval, then flesh out details.

Ask clarifying questions if the apotheosis goal itself is unclear (e.g., becoming a god, merging with an artifact, ascending to another plane, etc.).
